data.name: Outgunned Reimagined
data.description: My own take on dice for the Director's Cut system. Currently only Outgunned (OG) is presented, but I have ideas and plans to add Outgunned Adventure (OGA) and Outgunned Superheroes (OGS). No Plans or ideas for any Action Flicks, World of Killers, or Broken Compass. But that may change, who knows...
